constructor-arg.value: INSERT INTO Q_USER (ACCOUNT_ID, NAME, EMAIL, PASSWORD, BIRTHDAY, IS_ENABLED, LANG_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATED_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_DATE) VALUES (:accountId, :name, :email, :password, :birthday, :isEnabled, :language, :createdBy, :createdDate, :updatedBy, :updatedDate) ON CONFLICT (ACCOUNT_ID) DO UPDATE SET NAME = :name, EMAIL = :email, IS_ENABLED = :isEnabled, SURNAME = :surname, USERNAME = :username, LANG_ID = :language, BIRTHDAY = :birthday, AVATAR = :avatar, UPDATED_BY = :updatedBy, UPDATED_DATE = :updatedDate

INSERT INTO Q_USER (ACCOUNT_ID, NAME, EMAIL, PASSWORD, BIRTHDAY, IS_ENABLED, LANG_ID, CREATED_BY, CREATED_DATE, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_DATE) VALUES (:accountId, :name, :email, :password, :birthday, :isEnabled, :language, :createdBy, :createdDate, :updatedBy, :updatedDate) ON CONFLICT (ACCOUNT_ID) DO UPDATE SET NAME = :name, EMAIL = :email, IS_ENABLED = :isEnabled, SURNAME = :surname, USERNAME = :username, LANG_ID = :language, BIRTHDAY = :birthday, UPDATED_BY = :updatedBy, UPDATED_DATE = :updatedDate
INSERT INTO Q_USER_CATEGORY (ACCOUNT_ID, CAT_ID) SELECT :accountId, :catId WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Q_USER_CATEGORY WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = :accountId AND CAT_ID = :catId)

INSERT INTO Q_USER_OCCUPATION (ACCOUNT_ID, OCCUPATION_ID) SELECT :accountId, :occupationId WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Q_USER_OCCUPATION WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = :accountId AND OCCUPATION_ID = :occupationId)
UPDATE Q_USER SET password = :password WHERE email = :email
UPDATE Q_USER SET lang_id = :langId WHERE email = :email

SELECT u.account_id ,u.email ,u.password ,u.is_enabled ,u.is_blocked ,u.experience ,u.birthday ,u.name ,u.surname ,u.username ,u.avatar ,u.preferred_trophy ,u.last_seen_date ,u.login_streak ,u.best_streak ,u.coins ,u.streak_freezes ,u.tour_seen ,u.profile_visibility ,u.equipped_frame ,u.equipped_name_color ,u.created_date ,u.updated_date ,l.lang_id ,l.name as lang_name ,l.lang_code FROM Q_USER u LEFT JOIN Q_LANGUAGE l ON l.lang_id = u.lang_id WHERE u.email = :email
SELECT r.role_id ,r.name FROM Q_ROLE r LEFT JOIN Q_USER_ROLES ur ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.account_id = :accountId
SELECT c.cat_id ,c.name FROM Q_CATEGORY c LEFT JOIN Q_USER_CATEGORY uc ON c.cat_id = uc.cat_id WHERE uc.account_id = :accountId
SELECT o.id ,o.name ,o.domain ,o.status FROM Q_OCCUPATION o LEFT JOIN Q_USER_OCCUPATION uo ON o.id = uo.occupation_id WHERE uo.account_id = :accountId
SELECT u.* FROM Q_USER u WHERE u.account_id IN (:accountIds)

SELECT u.account_id ,u.email ,u.password ,u.is_enabled ,u.birthday ,u.name ,u.surname ,u.username ,r.role_id ,r.name as ROLE_NAME FROM Q_USER u LEFT JOIN Q_USER_ROLES ur ON u.account_id = ur.account_id LEFT JOIN Q_ROLE r ON ur.role_id = r.role_id
DELETE FROM Q_USER_CATEGORY WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = :accountId AND CAT_ID in (:ids)
DELETE FROM Q_USER_OCCUPATION WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = :accountId AND OCCUPATION_ID in (:ids)
UPDATE Q_USER SET IS_ENABLED = TRUE WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = :accountId
